response.sql:
SELECT
  m.Name AS MediaTypeName,
  AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageListPricePerTrack,
  AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track AS t
JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
GROUP BY m.Name;

assumptions.assumption: File size divided by track length means bytes per millisecond; zero-length tracks yield a missing ratio and are ignored by that average. AVG ignores NULL values, and returns NULL when there are no non-NULL values.
